title: fix(gateway): prevent plugin rollback from hanging shutdown
body:
Related: #157819, #157886, #158047

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes Gateway shutdown hanging when a plugin replacement fails while publishing its configuration.

## User Impact

Failed, uncommitted plugin replacement can restore the previous runtime and configured model context limits, propagate the original error, and finish shutdown. Existing configuration and stored data need no migration.

## Why This Change Was Made

Plugin replacement gates model-catalog readers until activation or rollback finishes. On publication failure, secret rollback awaited catalog discovery inside the callback that the enclosing plugin rollback was waiting to finish.

Rollback now uses the context owner's existing synchronous reset steps: advance the generation, remove candidate configured limits, and prime the restored configuration. Snapshot ownership checks, discovered-metadata ownership, and generation fencing remain intact. Normal committed refresh still loads the catalog.

## Evidence

- The original ordered config-patch flow reproduced the 180-second include-only cleanup-hook timeout. A bounded diagnostic captured the circular wait; all diagnostic source was restored before validation.
- With the final regression source, original production hit the unchanged **120,000 ms** test deadline: one failed, 17 unselected, **145.765 s command wall**. The candidate was restored and verified; all **18 owner cases passed** in **17.161 s wall**, including the regression in **263 ms**.
- The seven context/cache/plugin-recovery sibling files passed **212 tests**, and the handler suite passed **270 tests**. Their covered production and test inputs are unchanged. The existing rollback case is strengthened rather than duplicated; cleanup independently releases the real model gate, joins the full assertion task, then closes model ownership.
- Canonical focused lint passed. `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base origin/main` passed in **1,735.807 s**, including all 25 test type graphs and the selected lint, dependency, API, storage, and architecture guards.
- `pnpm build` passed in **658.039 s**; the complete tracked source tree was verified unchanged afterward.
- **20 consecutive uninstrumented runs** of `pnpm test src/gateway/server.config-patch.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --bail=1` passed all **81 cases each: 1,620 passes, zero failures, zero skips**. Original order, direct-to-file stdout, and deadlines were preserved. Combined test-command wall was **2,262.574 s**; every run verified the same candidate tree.
- Fresh independent Codex review is scoped-clean through P2. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36161271549) passed on `0b56977bfd72cfa8bbd756322f60593325e8c328`: **121 successful jobs, 19 expected skips**.

Measured test cost:

| File | Cases | Testbox command wall | Hosted CI reported case time |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `src/gateway/server-reload-managed-secrets.test.ts` | 18 | 17.161 s | 1.141 s |
| `src/gateway/server-reload-handlers.test.ts` | 270 | 40.066 s | 13.763 s for 268 of 270 cases |

Command wall uses `pnpm test <file> --maxWorkers=1`. CI timing is the sum of reported case durations, separate from process startup. Two successful handler-case durations were redacted in the hosted log, so its full sum is unavailable. Both files shared a 555-second CI job that also includes setup and other shard work. No test cases or assertions were removed, and no deadlines, retries, or skips were added.

Validation caught a handler-file growth limit, a fixture union-array type error, and a `prefer-const` lint error. Two redundant mock forwarders were removed, the fixture now uses its canonical provider type, and the assertion task is immutable. Initial CI stopped at that lint failure and cancelled sibling jobs; the corrected head passed its fresh CI run.

Heavy proof ran through the repository wrapper with provider **blacksmith-testbox**, exact source checks, frozen dependencies, and one active command per lease. The earlier lease became unreachable during a broad gate; that partial gate was not counted as passing. Final complete proof used lease `tbx_01m3cpjer3j5w7jppjne03cztd` ([bootstrap](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36161415164)); its validation command exited 0 and native stop confirmed it completed. All task leases are stopped. Bootstrap workflow cancellation during lease cleanup is separate from the recorded command outcomes.
